steps.handoff: mix.wav (voice voice-normalized.wav, bed bed.wav, ducking true, duck-db -12.0, target-lufs -16.0)

steps.verify: At least one cue, monotonic and non-overlapping.

steps.handoff: narrated.mp4 (composition narrated/, voice voice-normalized.wav, music bed.wav, subtitles transcript.srt)
steps.verify: Check the MP4 with an ffprobe probe.

steps.handoff: study-photo.png (script study/study.py, name study, width 1600, height 1000, engine cycles, exposure -0.6)
